```{r stdcoeffs_s, results = 'hide', warning = FALSE}

##standardized primary results
glu_slopes_s <- emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group,
                       infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

gaba_slopes_s <- emtrends(lmer_long_gaba_groupwise_s, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group,
                       infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

glu_gaba_slopes_s <- emtrends(lmer_long_glu_gaba_groupwise_s, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

glu_slopes_df_s <- glu_slopes_s %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_glu_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_glu_cn_neg,
         std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_glu_cn_neg) #sd_glu_cn_neg is the same for NeuroMET and NeuroMETs
gaba_slopes_df_s <- gaba_slopes_s %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_gaba_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_gaba_cn_neg,
         std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_gaba_cn_neg)
glu_gaba_slopes_df_s <- glu_gaba_slopes_s %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg, std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg)

```{r FigureS2, fig.align = "center", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,  results = "asis", fig.height = 12, fig.width=10, fig.cap= "**Fig. S2. Sensitivity analyses of group comparisons of longitudinal changes of 7T MRS neurotransmitter concentrations.** After removing an influential point at visit 4 in the AD Aβ + group, the estimated decline in glutamate levels in the AD Aβ+ group strengthened. The decline in the log(glutamate/glutamine) ratio in the AD Aβ+ group lost significance. Other longitudinal trajectories showed no meaningful differences from the primary analysis. Notably, this datapoint showed a correlated increase across glutamate (Fig. 1), GABA (Fig. 1), and glutamine (Fig. 3) simultaneously, a pattern more consistent with a measurement-level deviation at this visit than an independent biological change in each metabolite. However, we were unable to identify any technical error or clinical explanation for the strong deviation. All models were weighted based on Cramér–Rao lower bounds (CRLB), a common metric for quantifying uncertainty in MRS, with datapoint size in this figure reflecting the corresponding model weight; smaller datapoints indicate higher uncertainty (i.e., higher CRLBs). Amyloid-β positivity (Aβ +) was defined based on plasma p-Tau181, as indicated by the orange points. Displayed β coefficients and p-values indicate estimated annual change per group, based on estimated marginal trends. *Abbreviations: AD = Alzheimer’s disease, Aβ = amyloid-beta, CN = cognitively normal, CRLB = Cramér-Rao lower bound, GABA = gamma-aminobutyric acid, MCI = mild cognitive impairment, MRS = magnetic resonance spectroscopy.*"}

# Model Glutamate
# Define new data grid
new_data_glu_year <- expand.grid(
  year = seq(min(NeuroMETs$year, na.rm = TRUE), max(NeuroMETs$year, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100),
  diagnose_group = levels(factor(NeuroMETs$diagnose_group)),
  age_bl = mean(NeuroMETs$age_bl, na.rm = TRUE), # Fixed age at mean
  sex = as.factor(1)   # or change to "male" or both if needed
)

label_positions <- new_data_glu_year %>%
  group_by(diagnose_group) %>%
  summarise(x = max(year), y = 17.75, .groups = "drop")
coef_glu <- data.frame(emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s, ~ diagnose_group, var = "year")) %>% mutate(label = paste0("β = ", sprintf("%.2f",year.trend), " [",  sprintf("%.2f",lower.CL), "; ", sprintf("%.2f", upper.CL), "]\n", "p = ", sprintf("%.3f",(emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s, ~ diagnose_group, var = "year")%>% test())$p.value))) %>% select(diagnose_group, label)%>%
  left_join(label_positions, by = "diagnose_group")

# Predict values
preds <- predict(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s, newdata = new_data_glu_year, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)

# Store predictions and confidence intervals
new_data_glu_year$pred <- preds$fit
new_data_glu_year$lower <- preds$fit - 1.96 * preds$se.fit
new_data_glu_year$upper <- preds$fit + 1.96 * preds$se.fit

p1 <- ggplot(new_data_glu_year, aes(x = year, y = pred, color = diagnose_group)) +
 
  geom_line(data=NeuroMETs %>% filter(!is.na(diagnose_group) & !is.na(glu)), 
            aes(x = year, y = glu, group=record_id, color=diagnose_group), alpha=0.5) +
  # geom_point(data=NeuroMETs %>% filter(!is.na(diagnose_group) & !is.na(glu)), 
  #            aes(x = year, y = glu, group=record_id, color=diagnose_group, size = glu_CRLB), alpha=0.5) +
  geom_point(data=NeuroMETs %>% filter(!is.na(pTau_group)), aes(x = year, y = glu, color = pTau_group, size = glu_CRLB),  alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = diagnose_group), linetype = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Glutamate [mmol/L]",
       color = "Clinical Diagnosis at visit 1",
       fill = "Clinical Diagnosis at visit 1") +
  facet_wrap(~diagnose_group, nrow = 1) +  
  geom_text(data = coef_glu, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), color = "black", hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c(diagnose_colors, diagnose_colors[4], diagnose_colors[1])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(diagnose_colors, diagnose_colors[4], diagnose_colors[1])) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.8, 2.5), name = "CRLB-based size") +  # optional legend
  guides(fill= "none") +
  #theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = 'top', 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85",colour = NA),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x= element_line(colour = "black"))

  theme(legend.position = 'none', 
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x= element_line(colour = "black"),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

figureS2 <- p1/p2/p3/p4/p5 

ggsave(
     filename = "figureS2.jpeg",
     plot = figureS2,
     width = 9,  
     height = 12,
     dpi = 300
 )
